question: Which doctor handled the most visits?
sql: SELECT doctors.name FROM doctors JOIN visits ON doctors.doc_id = visits.doctor_id GROUP BY doctors.doc_id ORDER BY COUNT(visits.visit_id) DESC LIMIT 50
